Everything from the underlayment to the shingles is designed to work together to form the most resilient roof you could ever hope to own. And the high-level skills of our installers allow us to offer the GAF Golden Pledge Warranty to our clients, protecting them from installation issues for 25 years.
At Firon Roofing, “good enough” isn’t good enough. We refuse to compromise on quality — from the materials you see to the layers you don’t. Every detail is built to last, because your home deserves nothing less.

Customer-focused policies.
No matter when you call Firon Roofing, an employee will answer the phone – even at 3am on a holiday.
We keep you informed throughout the project – we never leave you guessing.
If all you need is a repair, we’ll get it done – most companies refuse to do repairs.
Every step of the way, our goal is to ensure you are treated fairly and respectfully, and that you are blown away by the end results.
At Firon Roofing, we don’t just install roofs — we protect your peace of mind. With top-tier materials, expert workmanship, and a quality-first mindset, your roofing investment is safe, smart, and built to last.

With a foundation in business strategy, we flipped the script on traditional roofing by creating systems that deliver reliability, transparency, and long-term value. From adopting digital tools long before the rest of the industry caught up, to treating training as an ongoing investment, we’ve turned what’s often a stressful experience into one that’s smooth, informed, and refreshingly professional. Our success comes from refusing to cut corners, embracing technology, elevating standards, and always putting our customers first — with results that speak for themselves.

Business Before Builds

Business Before Builds
Here’s a truth that so few recognise – excellence at your trade is no guarantee of excellence in business.
Sadly, few roofing contractors consider the business side of things when they start their roofing companies. All they are concerned with is finding bodies to hold the hammers and getting that next job.
The only possible result from such practices is failure – and the fact that few roofing companies last longer than five years proves the point.
So I took my business training and applied it to the roofing industry. The results were dramatic – if not surprising. Suddenly, I had a viable company with values and processes that would lead to success instead of dissolution.
And even better, my customers were delighted to find that replacing their roofs could be a smooth and enjoyable process. We showed up when we said we would, kept our promises, and did our best to head off issues before they turned into crises.
Our system of checking and rechecking and always looking ahead allows us to weather changes in the market and supply issues with little to no effect on the customer experience we provide.
Instead of hoping for the best, we plan for storms so that we’re prepared no matter what is waiting around the bend.
Digital Wonders
One of the largest errors I observed in the roofing trade was a refusal to embrace the digital age. Oh, their records were computerised, but that’s about as far as it went.
At Firon Roofing, we were one of the first to use satellite imagery to measure our customers’ roofs accurately as far back as 2010. When our project managers show up for an initial visit, they come armed with a good idea of how much material you’ll need to replace your roof.
With those satellite measurements and our proposal app, our estimators can offer exceptionally accurate proposals for each homeowner.
We’ve also embraced all modern forms of communication and use phone calls, emails, and texting to keep our clients informed and software to track each project as it moves through each step of the roof replacement process.
One thing I learned while working for others was that customers hate to hear the words “I don’t know,” so I created a system that allows all our team members to access the necessary information on any roofing project right away.
We did away with “I don’t know” and replaced it with “Let me check.”
Using Commercial Standards
There’s a reason traditional residential roofing companies don’t do commercial work. The high standards, expected longevity, and tracking requirements of a commercial project demand a high level of organisation, safety, and communication, which most residential roofers simply don’t possess.
When I started Firon Roofing, I wanted to apply those commercial standards to the residential roofing world and provide superior quality roofing to business customers.
Our digitally-based process makes providing the detailed approach of commercial quality work to homeowners a breeze. We always know where every project stands, who is in charge of it, and where the materials are at any moment.
Homeowners crave this level of continuity and transparency – and we’re glad to provide it at every step.
Training = Excellence
Industry standards don’t have much to say about training installers. After all, roofing crews often change from one job to the next. It’s a physically demanding job, and only the hardiest workers will return after their first installation.
Uneven pay schedules, ever-changing workloads, and zero chance of advancement are a constant in the roofing industry, so loyalty from roofing workers is understandably rare.
We take a different tact at Firon Roofing. We knew that building a good, reliable crew that could live up to our standards was key and worth investing the time and energy to make that happen.
We continue to train new crews and also engage in regular meetings to discuss and solve any issues that may come up. We also use factory training and encourage our workers to attend all available sessions.
As new items come to market and new techniques are developed, we are always at the front of the line for the next training program. Training is not something that happens once – it’s a continual need that we are happy to satisfy.
Manufacturer Input
Often, the goal of winning the low bid pushes concerns about quality to the side. More often than not, this results in what we call Franken-roofs, with different manufacturers used for each component of your roof system – components that fit together poorly.
We take a different position on project bids, preferring to offer the best value rather than the lowest bid. So we partnered with
GAF
, a company that’s been in the asphalt roofing business for well over 100 years.
Working with one manufacturer for most of your product line is a huge advantage. We still offer a choice between good, better, and best, but even the good option is far superior to what most others can supply.
And as a
GAF Master Elite Contractor
, we are among the top 2% of roofing companies in the entire North American continent, and GAF is a big reason we achieved that goal.
Their training programs, product quality, and exceptional customer service allow us to provide the same (and better) to each of our clients.
I look forward to delivering the same quality installations and exceptional service to Firon Roofing customers for decades to come.

Our Process
About Us
Experience roofing done right — the Firon Roofing way.
Our process is designed to eliminate stress, ensure total transparency, and deliver exceptional results with military-grade precision. From the very first handshake to the final inspection, we make the entire experience smooth, supportive, and refreshingly human.
At Firon Roofing, we’ve reimagined the roofing process from top to bottom. Our stress-free home visits start with accurate satellite measurements and a conversation — not a sales pitch. Whether it’s a quick repair or a full replacement, we tailor solutions to your needs, offer clear proposals, and never pressure you to sign. Behind the scenes, our communication is crystal clear, our standards uncompromising, and our project oversight continuous — with real-time photo checks and dual inspections. For investors, tenants, or homeowners working with insurance claims, our commercial-grade systems, empathy, and industry expertise ensure peace of mind. With Firon Roofing, you're never in the dark — and never disappointed.
The Stress-Free Home Visit
Let’s face it - like most Ottawa homeowners, you’ve probably dealt with some fairly unpleasant initial visits from a home contractor. Strange silences, constant pressure to sign, and
not being heard
are just some of the unpleasant features homeowners have come to expect from a sales visit.
But with Firon Roofing, we don’t come to your home to sell you anything. Our project manager’s primary goal is to find out if we can help you
define and solve
your roofing problem. So, they come armed with satellite images and accurate measurements of your roof.
Then, they sit down with you to discover why your roof has you concerned, your goals for a new roof, and the budget you have in mind. Once they have a full understanding of the facts, they perform a thorough inspection of your roof.
Unlike other roofing companies that merely walk outside with a pair of binoculars, our project managers get
onto your roof
to look for any additional problems or weaknesses in your roofing structure.
Sometimes, all your roof needs is a simple repair. If that’s wharl we find, we’ll offer a handful of options to suit your goal and budget rather than trying to sell you on a full roof replacement.
But if you
do need
a new roof, we use software to create a detailed proposal with good, better, and best options for replacing your roof. Each system will still give you a roof that will serve you well for decades, but some will have more bells and whistles than others.
And there is never any pressure to sign right away. We
want
you to explore other companies and even teach you how to distinguish good companies from bad ones.
We know that no other roofing company can offer the
value
Firon Roofing can provide for each of your hard-earned dollars, but it’s always good to give homeowners pressure-free time to come to the same conclusion.
Partnering With Property Investors
One area many residential roofers try to avoid is the multi-unit housing market. They find the roofs are often complicated and that dealing with multiple tenants can be difficult.
We agree with these opinions – but rather than roadblocks, we see them as
challenges to overcome.
A complicated roof is still a roof; it just requires patience and care. As for considering the needs of multiple tenants, you just need to be flexible and understanding.
Our project managers are adept at plotting how to replace a multi-dimensional roof and are skilled at soothing the worries of each tenant involved. If there is something we can do to make the build process
easier
on a tenant, then that’s what we’ll do.
And for the business owners themselves, we have a commercial-level approach to everything we do, so we can offer them the tracking data they need to satisfy their record-keeping needs.
Backing Your Insurance Claims
Dealing with insurance claims can be an unpleasant experience, but once we’re brought into the process, we can take
all that hassle
on for you. We’ll work directly with your adjuster to ensure that you get the repairs you need up to and including a replacement roof.
Unlike your average homeowner, we speak the adjuster’s language and know the information they need to approve the work.
Insurance companies know our reputation for
not adding
unnecessary work – which means they trust what we tell them and usually approve our recommendations without hesitation.
Crystal Clear Communication
Another big complaint from homeowners about the roofing industry is being left out of the loop. That will never happen with Firon Roofing.
Even
before
we meet face to face, we’re updating you. The day before your first visit, you’ll get a call verifying your appointment time, the name of your project manager, and the basics of the work you want to be completed.
After the visit, you’ll get a welcoming text going over some of the specifics of your visit. And if you agree to the proposal, you’ll get another call from our production team within two days to verify everything in your proposal.
On the days approaching your installation, you’ll get a series of emails going over your installation dates, what you can expect during the process, and how to prepare your property for the work.
Each morning, the crew chief will discuss the particulars of the day’s work, ask for any concerns you might have, and then
address them
as needed.
At every step, you are kept informed, and your questions are gladly answered.
Constant Oversight
At each step of installing your replacement roof, our crews take images of their work and upload them to our office, where they are reviewed in real-time. This process allows us to spot any problems to get them solved before the next stage covers them up.
Our production manager will also stop in from time to time to check on your project's progress and the work's quality.
Once your new roof is complete, the crew chief will inspect every inch of your roof. Then, our production manager will perform a second inspection with you by their side. Your roofing project will not be considered finished until your crew chief, your project manager, and yourself agree that the work is complete and correct.
Unbending Standards
We never have and will never just slap shingles down and call it done. We always strip your roof down to the wood decking to ensure there aren’t any
hidden problems.
If we find rot that we should have caught – it’s on us, and we’ll make it right on our own dime.
We follow the manufacturer’s recommendations
to the letter
at every step and always make our choices based on what’s right rather than what’s cheapest.
We even use calculations based on the shape of your roof, the climate, and the materials involved to plot
exactly

Architectural shingles and designer shingles are excellent for Ottawa’s freeze-thaw cycles, snow loads, and high winds. Metal roofing is also a durable, energy-efficient choice for long-term performance.
What does a roof inspection include?
A professional roof inspection includes checking shingles, flashing, vents, gutters, caulking, and attic ventilation. It helps identify current or potential issues before they become expensive problems.
How much does a new roof cost in Ottawa?
Roof replacement costs in Ottawa vary based on size, slope, materials, and complexity. Most residential projects range from $8,000 to $20,000+. Contact Firon Roofing for a detailed quote tailored to your home.
Is attic ventilation really that important?
Yes, attic ventilation prevents heat and moisture buildup that can lead to premature shingle failure, mould growth, and high energy bills. A properly vented attic is critical to your roof’s longevity.

True Roof Inspections
While other roofing contractors rely on an inspection from the ground, we prefer to take a closer look.
There’s only so much you can see through a pair of binoculars.
One of the first things our estimators do when they get to your home is climb on top of your roof, or if it is not safe to do so, they will deploy a drone to ensure they get a close look. From there, they can see the small cracks and failures that just aren’t visible from the ground.
They can also get a better feel for the strength of your roof as they walk along its surface. After all, not every soft spot in your decking system is kind enough to sag noticeably. Often, the only way to find these weak areas is to feel them under your feet.
They can also assess your flashing, gutters, and penetration points more thoroughly when they are at eye level.
By the time your estimator climbs down their ladder, they’ll know precisely where your roof stands and what type of service you need to solve your roofing problems.
We don’t guess from the ground — we get up there. Our inspectors walk your roof (or fly a drone) to catch issues others miss and give you real answers.

Protect your home from costly water damage with Firon Roofing’s professional flashing repair services. Our experts perform meticulous inspections, use modern techniques and quality materials, and deliver flashing repairs that last for decades.
Professional flashing repair services for Ottawa homeowners
Few roofing failures can cause as much damage to your home’s interior than leaky flashing. Instead of protecting your home, worn flashing can become a conduit sending water
deep
into your home’s interior.
The structural damage resulting from such a leak can cost you tens of thousands of dollars before you even know it’s there.
And since flashing is one of the most popular ways for unscrupulous roofers to cut costs, bad flashing is
everywhere.
Detailed Inspections
Flashing is responsible for protecting the weak points of your roof from developing water leaks. It can be found
anywhere
your roof abuts a vertical surface, like a chimney, wall, or penetrating vent.
The slightest failure can cause a leak into the interior of your home. So, when we inspect your roof for flashing failures,
we do so with the utmost attention to detail
.
We lift shingles and get low to check for insufficient or missing step flashing. We then make sure there is a proper leak barrier, which is
essential
for keeping water from running sideways and onto your roof decking. Another thing on our list is to check for any cracks in the caulking and flashing material.
We know how important flashing is to the lifespan of your roof (and home), so we take our time to
ensure
we find every weakness in your roof’s flashing and offer the proper solutions.
Superior Methods
Some roofing companies will reuse your old, worn-out flashing – but not Firon Roofing.
At Firon Roofing, we replace any flashing that has lost its structural integrity. But if the issue is merely worn caulk, we are comfortable with simply pulling away the old caulk and laying a new line of high-quality caulking.
At times, we will run into flashing that was just
poorly executed.
Instead of trying to force it into working, we’ll take the time to install new flashing using the proper methods and materials, including placing an ice and water shield where needed.

Ventilation Issues

Precisely calculated attic venting solutions for Greater Ottawa Area homeowners
The roof on your Ottawa area home needs to breathe if you want it to last its full lifespan. Otherwise, heat build-up and mould infestations can
slowly degrade
your roof’s ability to do its job.
Proper ventilation isn’t a guessing game. Each roof is
unique
and has specific needs. At Firon Roofing, we use software to calculate exactly how much ventilation your roof needs and where it should be located.
Precision Planning
Every roof is different, so ventilation systems need to be
custom-designed
to fit each individual roof. Of course, we need to account for the size and shape of the roof structure, but that’s not where it ends.
The amount and type of insulation in the attic space need to be considered, as well as any fixtures or equipment that may
change
the conditions or airflow within the space.
Our software can take all this information and give the perfect solution for your and
only your
roof.
Multiple Solutions
Once we have the answer to the amount of ventilation your roof needs, we can adapt it to various available products.
Ridge vents are the
top-shelf
solution to most ventilation needs. They are nearly invisible and offer exceptional airflow. They are also very expensive, mostly because we would need to cut a channel along your roof ridge when installing the venting.
Other options can achieve the same effect but are far more visible than a ridge vent.
Power vents are popular because the largest of them can cover the needs of up to 1200 sq ft of roofing surface. That means
fewer holes
in your roof, and fewer holes are always preferred over more holes. But not everyone likes the look of power vents.
There are smaller vents that work well, but you’ll need more of them to cover the same space. Then again, they are far more attractive than power vents due to their low profiles.
No matter your priorities or budget, we have a solution that will work for your roof.

them. Often, they use higher-quality materials than recommended to ensure that their work will last until long after they’ve retired.

properly
, you should see immediate results. Your roof will be cooler in the summer and less prone to ice build-up in the winter. Mould colonies will find the balanced air in your attic inhospitable. the smooth new look of your roof.

Roof Tune-ups
Firon Roofing’s comprehensive roof tune-ups help Ottawa homeowners prevent major roof issues by proactively addressing caulking, flashing, shingles, and more—saving time, stress, and costly repairs.
Ottawa homeowners stay on top of things with roof tune-ups from Firon Roofing
Though the roof on your Ottawa home may look pretty simple, it’s actually a complicated system with multiple components that work together to keep wind and water out of your home or business.
Every roof has a predetermined lifespan, but few ever make it to their expected date of failure. When your roof was first installed, a clock started ticking. And every failure to address problems speeds that clock up.
While your shingles usually survive the years, the supporting materials usually have a shorter lifespan. Maintaining or replacing these components before they fail will let your entire roof system perform as expected for its full lifespan.
Our Roof Tune-Up is Thorough
Our Roof Tune-Up Service is designed to address the weaker portions of your roof system to avoid early failures with actions such as:
Full Caulking Service
Caulking comes in many forms, and most roofing companies tend to use whatever is cheapest.
Cheap caulking will crack and peel just from the effects of the sun. So we go through your entire system to check for and replace any caulking that is failing or on the verge of failure.
Flashing Inspection
Flashing is a critical part of your roof system. If your flashing has cracks or insufficient ice and water block, it will guide water straight into your roof’s wooden decking.
This water will damage your roof and make its way into your home, wreaking havoc everywhere it reaches.
Debris Removal
Debris can cause serious problems for your roof. It can trap water, giving standing pools of water time to soak through to the wood underneath. Debris can be as simple as leaves, as tenacious as moss, or as seemingly innocent as a tennis ball.
Leaves and moss prevent the free movement of rainwater, and tennis balls have been known to block the downspouts of eaves troughs. Any of these situations can steal years of life from your roof.
Shingle Repair
As part of our tune-up service, we will repair up to a full pack of shingles on your roof. Wind damage is the most common cause of shingle damage, followed closely by hail damage.
Hail can cause the protective layer of granules on a shingle to fly away, leaving bare sections that are not protected from sunlight which will cause the shingle to fail earlier than it should.
Gutter Inspection
When water leaves your roof, it is channelled safely away from your home by your eavestroughs. But if those troughs are filled with dirt and other debris, that water has nowhere to go.
Eventually, the water will wear a path to the lowest layers of your roof and soak into the wood. It can also drop behind poorly installed gutters and cause your fascia to rot away.
Regular inspections and cleaning will eliminate this risk to your roofing system and ensure that the water goes where it should and never where it shouldn’t.
Catch Trouble Early
The earlier you spot a problem, the cheaper it will be to fix it. But if you wait until you see signs of roof trouble in your home, you can face repair bills running into five figures.
And even small issues on your roof can turn into trouble in a hurry.
But when you have a professional looking at your roof each year, these issues will get caught before things get out of hand.
Even if the problem is beyond the scope of our standard tune-up, simply spotting it and coming up with a plan can save you from replacing your roof years or even decades before you should have to.
And since most roof failures are set in place during installation, the sooner you get a true pro looking at your roof, the better. We know the shortcuts other roofers take and the flaws inherent in earlier roof designs, so we know exactly where to look for trouble.
More importantly, we know how to make it go away.
Prepare For The Future
There are certain times when it just makes sense to give your roof a once-over.
If you intend to sell your home, an official roof inspection is in your future. With our roofing tune-up, you can rest easy knowing that your roof will easily pass or know what you need to do to ensure a good result.
And if you wish to add solar to your home, those panels need a straight, strong surface to mount to. Our roof tune-up is a quick, inexpensive way to ensure that your Ottawa roof is ready to take on all that extra weight.

Snow and Ice Removal
Snow and ice buildup can wreak havoc on your Ottawa roof. Firon Roofing offers expert snow and ice removal services to prevent structural damage, stop dangerous ice dams, and keep your home safe through winter.
Snow and ice removal services protect your home from Ottawa’s harsh winter weather
Ottawa homeowners and businesses deal with snow and ice through much of the year, which is hard on their roofs.
Snow can weigh more than 50kg per cubic meter as it packs down with each fresh snowfall, with ice coming in at over 900kg. These tremendous weights can cause incredible damage to your home if they break free.
Periodic ice and snow removal is the best way to protect your home from winter weather damage and ensure it will last for years to come.
How snow removal helps your roof
Snow-covered rooftops are a beautiful feature of winter weather, but all that beauty can mask serious trouble if you let it build up too high.
The weight alone can cause strain on your roof structure, but that’s not the true threat unless you experience record-breaking snowfall.
The bigger problem is that the snow packs down from its own weight, which can impede the motion of the snowmelt. As this water moves toward your eavestroughs, it can refreeze before it gets there.
Once you’ve formed a layer of ice beneath the snow, it will continue to grow until it forms an ice dam.
Removing the snow from your roof before it gets too deep ensures that the snowmelt will leave your roof quickly.
What is an ice dam?
While it’s almost certain you’ve heard the term ice dam, it isn’t so certain that you know what they are or how they form.
An ice dam is a buildup of ice along the edges of your roof.
Icicles, pretty as they may be, are your roof’s way of crying for help.
When you see icicles around someone’s home, you can be positive that they have an ice dam. Once an ice dam forms, it will only grow larger and more dangerous until the spring thaw.
These ice formations can weigh as much as 900+kg per cubic meter and put tremendous strain on your roof. And if one section were to let go, anything beneath it would get destroyed.
That could be your car, part of your home, or just the foliage around your home. We’ve also seen ice dams catch on the gutters and swing into the side of a home, tearing up the siding as the gutters are ripped from their mountings.
When you’re dealing with this much weight, nothing can stop it, and virtually anything is possible.
Ice dam solutions
At Firon Roofing, we understand what it takes to protect your home from ice dam catastrophes. The main issue is giving the snowmelt a place to go besides piling up and refreezing on your roof.
If the buildup isn’t too bad, we can simply get rid of the ice and ensure that your eaves troughs aren’t clogged.
But when the ice dams become too large, the best solution is to cut troughs into the ice that the meltwater can use to leave the roof.
The scale of the ice dam and the properties of your roof determine which method is best to handle your ice dam troubles. Our long experience with Ottawa winters and roofing expertise help us make that decision.

Ventilation Upgrade Services
Firon Roofing’s computer-designed attic ventilation systems offer Ottawa homeowners a modern solution to prevent roof overheating, moisture damage, and energy loss. With multiple venting options and expert installation, we ensure your roof performs at its best for years to come.
Computer-designed attic ventilation upgrades to better protect the roofs of Ottawa homes
Once upon a time, Ottawa roofers treated attic ventilation as an afterthought. Today, we know better.
Proper attic ventilation is essential for extending the lifespan of your roof. Sadly, many modern roofers still don’t give ventilation enough attention. They will recommend venting based only on the area of your roof and ignore every other factor.
At Firon Roofing, we take pride in the quality of our roof systems, and ample ventilation is a big part of our success.
The dangers of poor attic ventilation
Your roof’s surface temperature can reach beyond 60 degrees on a warm summer day. All that heat (and the humidity it creates) gets trapped in your attic space without proper attic ventilation.
This excessive heat buildup can break down your shingles, significantly shortening their lifespan. But the heat also makes it more difficult to cool your home, so your AC system is working overtime, raising your energy bills and increasing the chance that it, too, will fail earlier than it should.
Ventilation is about more than roof temperature
The humidity drawn into your attic is allowed to stay due to low airflow, allowing mould to form within the space. This then becomes a potential health issue for your whole family.
In extreme conditions, this extra moisture can damage the structural surfaces of your home. Since few homeowners visit their attics, these moist and mouldy conditions can become a huge problem before you even know they exist.
The last thing you want is to discover your roof is on its last legs, you have a serious mould problem, and there is real damage within the walls of your home.
Attic venting solutions for everyone
We have access to multiple venting technologies, allowing us to match your venting needs with your sense of style and budget.
Ridge Vents
The gold standard of roof venting is the ridge vent. With a ridge vent, the area where two sections of roof meet in a ridge is left open to the air and covered with a vent that runs the entire length. These vents are virtually invisible from the ground, which is always desirable.
Unfortunately, installing one can be quite expensive if you don’t already have a ridge vent. If a ridge vent is a bigger expense than you want to take on, there are still plenty of options.
Power Vents
Power vents have become extremely popular. A single power vent can be rated to serve up to 111 square meters of roof surface. These vents are true powerhouses but are much more visible from the street than a ridge vent.
Many feel that only having to cut one hole for every 111 square meters of roof surface is worth the less subtle look.
Low-Profile Venting
Low-profile vents come in a variety of forms. Finding the best one to fit your home is easy enough, but it will require several low-profile vents to serve the average roof properly.
And, of course, more vents equals more holes. But those who want discreet vents consider the look a fair trade for the extra holes in their roof system.
No matter your situation or need, we have the venting system you want and the expertise needed to install it correctly for decades of trouble-free use.
Quality ventilation work – guaranteed
Our computer-designed ventilation systems give Ottawa homeowners a roof that stays relatively cool in the summer and ensures that humidity levels never get too high in your attic. Few Ottawa roofing companies have anything that comes close to our software.
Every non-ridge-based vent we install is made of metal. The plastic systems available on the market can’t hold up against the sun for more than twenty years, so we refuse to use them.
Our venting systems usually give you trouble-free performance for the rest of your roof’s life. Plus, we use ice and water shield wherever needed, which is where most local roofers prefer to cut costs.

Skylights & Accessories
B2B Roofing Solutions
At Firon Roofing, we help Ottawa homeowners bring more light, safety, and efficiency into their homes with modern skylights, energy-saving sun tunnels, ice-stopping snow guards, and clog-free gutter solutions.
Whether you're brightening up a dark hallway or protecting your home from winter hazards, our expertly installed accessories deliver beauty, performance, and peace of mind—season after season.
At Firon Roofing, we brighten your home with beautifully installed skylights
In these days of high energy bills, anything you can do to reduce your energy consumption in Ottawa is a great move. Skylights and sun tunnels are a great way to keep your home’s interior illuminated during the day without using electricity.
They can bring natural light to any location in your home, even a walk-in closet or a dark hallway.
And our snow stoppers and gutter guards are great for eliminating ice dam troubles and clogged gutters. There is no more important task than moving water away from your home, and these accessories help ensure that snowmelt and rainwater go where they should.
Not Your Grandparent’s Skylights
When they first came out, skylights were considered a great way to introduce leaks into your home. But those days are long past.
Modern skylight technology has eliminated the leak problem and added some great features. Depending on the model, new skylights can come with blinds between the panes that can be adjusted through house power, solar power, or your own hands.
There are also venting skylights that you can open to give your home better airflow.
With our skylights' improved designs, better looks, and increased functionality, paired with our ever-increasing energy bills, there’s never been a better time to replace your old skylight or add new ones to your home.
Sun Tunnels are like Magic
Sun tunnels are an economical choice that allows you to bring light into otherwise dark areas of your home. Common places to find sun tunnels are laundry rooms, walk-in closets, and long hallways.
These simple tubes lined with reflective material are mounted on your roof and run through your attic, much like standard vents. They collect the light from the roof and guide it to the space of your choice.
All that is visible inside your home is a lens cover that looks just like any other flush-mount lighting assembly.
The nice thing about sun tunnels is their ability to redirect light to where you need it without needing a hole directly above. So, you can pick the perfect spot on your roof for a new penetration, and then move the light anywhere you’d like from there.
Snow Stoppers = Winter Protection
If you’ve spent any time cruising through the internet, you’ve likely seen videos of huge swaths of snow and ice plummeting from a homeowner’s roof. While those videos can be entertaining, the danger from such snow dumps is quite real.
Those brief waterfalls of snow and ice can weigh a full ton and damage everything they hit.
Snow stoppers keep that from happening with their sturdy bars. Those bars keep the snow in place, far from the edge of your roof. So when temperatures rise, the snow is kept from sliding off in a single massive chunk.
They also make ice dams less likely as they keep the full weight of the snow on your roof from compacting the snow at the edge.
Gutter Guards that Really Work
There are many types of gutter guards available to Ottawa homeowners, but only a handful truly work as advertised.
We’ve selected “Gutter Clean” by Alurex for its balance between performance, cost, and quality. These aluminum gutter guards slip neatly over your existing gutters without interfering with your roof edge.
Their design is perfect for keeping debris larger than a pine needle out of your eavestroughs without the high visibility of the large, expensive, helmet-like systems available today.
And since they are made of aluminum, they won’t rust or rot away like some options offered by our competitors. With Gutter Clean, you get a long-lasting solution that performs well and doesn't change the look of your home.

Have questions about roofing? You’re not alone.
At Firon Roofing, we believe informed homeowners make better decisions — which is why we’ve compiled answers to the most common questions we hear about roof repairs, replacements, warranties, materials, and more. Whether you’re planning a new roof, dealing with a leak, or just curious about what to expect, this FAQ section has you covered with expert insights tailored to Ottawa’s unique climate and roofing needs.
How long does a roof typically last in Ottawa?
In Ottawa’s harsh climate, a well-installed asphalt shingle roof can last 20 to 30 years, depending on materials and maintenance. High-quality architectural or designer shingles may last 40 years or more with proper care.
What are the signs I need a new roof?
Common signs include missing shingles, curling or buckling shingles, granule loss, water stains on ceilings, or visible sagging. If your roof is over 20 years old, it’s time for a professional inspection.
Can you replace a roof in the winter?
Yes, we can replace roofs in the winter, though it requires extra precautions. Firon Roofing uses cold-weather techniques and materials to ensure a successful installation even during Ottawa’s colder months.
What is the best roofing material for Ottawa’s climate?
Architectural shingles and designer shingles are excellent for Ottawa’s freeze-thaw cycles, snow loads, and high winds. Metal roofing is also a durable, energy-efficient choice for long-term performance.
What does a roof inspection include?
A professional roof inspection includes checking shingles, flashing, vents, gutters, caulking, and attic ventilation. It helps identify current or potential issues before they become expensive problems.
How much does a new roof cost in Ottawa?
Roof replacement costs in Ottawa vary based on size, slope, materials, and complexity. Most residential projects range from $8,000 to $20,000+. Contact Firon Roofing for a detailed quote tailored to your home.
Is attic ventilation really that important?
Yes, attic ventilation prevents heat and moisture buildup that can lead to premature shingle failure, mould growth, and high energy bills. A properly vented attic is critical to your roof’s longevity.
Does my roof warranty cover labour?
Many standard warranties do not, but Firon Roofing offers systems backed by full labour, materials, and disposal warranties — including up to 50 years of defect coverage and 25 years on workmanship.
What should I ask a roofing contractor before hiring?
Ask about licensing, insurance, experience, warranties, and whether they use subcontractors. Make sure the roofer will provide a written quote and detailed scope of work. Firon Roofing checks all the boxes.
Can solar panels be installed on an older roof?
Technically yes, but it’s best to install solar panels on a newer or recently inspected roof. If your roof is over 10 years old, a roof tune-up or replacement may be recommended before adding solar.
